prompt: Trace logout and mutation invalidation with the installed Next.js version.

obligations.assertion: Respect authorized scope, preserve unrelated edits, and perform no unauthorized external action.
Do not invent execution, performance, manual accessibility, physical-device or client-invocation evidence.
Apply the identified workflow within its invocation contract.
Trace cookies/session state, logout and mutation invalidation as distinct boundaries.
Name the actual stale data path and evidence needed to prove invalidation.
When auth, cookies or cache capabilities are absent, report Not Needed for that capability without adding it.
